title: grammitis plana
intro: Grammitis plana, commonly known as the flat rock fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, fever reduction, and respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Grammitis plana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in relieving coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
